accuracy_impact.boundary: tool ran on a small fixture only; not dataset accuracy or silicon behavior

array_assumptions.boundary: not analog macro layout, extraction, or signoff

device_assumptions.boundary: small tool-execution fixture, not calibrated silicon
device_assumptions.programming_error: represented by explicit output-difference measurement when available

provenance.claim_boundary: strict simulator payload for a small optional fixture only; not measured silicon, board runtime, measured power, physical signoff, or production readiness

temperature_range.boundary: no temperature sweep in optional adapter fixture

voltage_range.boundary: adapter fixture voltage, not measured board supply behavior
